50043-poems.title: Poems.
50043-poems.creator: Maurice Maeterlinck
50043-poems.description: A book by Maurice Maeterlinck. -a movement very loosely named, since the actual symbolists connected with it could be counted on the fingers of one hand. More particularly were they influenced by the tendency to put music before matter, beauty before sense, which is expressed by the so familiar lines of Verlaine:

arxiv-1904-12763.title: Logic for exact real arithmetic Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Union’s 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 731143. The second author is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellow of the Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica
arxiv-1904-12763.creator: Helmut Schwichtenberg \rsuper a, Franziskus Wiesnet \rsuper b
arxiv-1904-12763.description: Abstract . Continuing earlier work of the first author with U. Berger, K. Miyamoto and H. Tsuiki, it is shown how a division algorithm for real numbers given as a stream of signed digits can be extracted from an appropriate formal proof.

arxiv-2102-11127.title: Graph-based Hierarchical Relevance Matching Signals for Ad-hoc Retrieval Conference: Proceedings of the Web Conference 2021; April 19–23, 2021; Ljubljana, Slovenia Proceedings of the Web Conference 2021 (WWW ’21), April 19–23, 2021, Ljubljana, Slovenia DOI: 10.1145/3442381.3450115 ISBN: 978-1-4503-8
arxiv-2102-11127.creator: Xueli Yu 1,∗ , Weizhi Xu 1,2,∗ , Zeyu Cui 1,2 , Shu Wu 1,2,† , Liang Wang 1,2
arxiv-2102-11127.description: Abstract . The ad-hoc retrieval task is to rank related documents given a query and a document collection. A series of deep learning based approaches have been proposed to solve such problem and gained lots of attention. However, we argue that they are inherently based on local word sequences, ignoring the subtle long-distance document-level word relationships.

arxiv-2208-00010.title: On Baryon and Lepton Number Violation
arxiv-2208-00010.creator: Pavel Fileviez Pérez (Editor), Andrea Pocar (Editor), K. S. Babu, Leah J. Broussard, Vincenzo Cirigliano, Susan Gardner, Julian Heeck, Ed Kearns, Andrew J. Long, Stuart Raby, Richard Ruiz, Evelyn Thomson, Carlos E. M. Wagner, Mark B. Wise
arxiv-2208-00010.description: Abstract SNOWMASS 2021 REPORT: RF4: BARYON AND LEPTON NUMBER VIOLATING PROCESSES RARE PROCESSES AND PRECISION MEASUREMENTS FRONTIER I Introduction The Standard Model (SM) of Particle Physics describes with high precision the properties of quarks and leptons, and how they interact through the electromagnetic, weak and strong forces.

arxiv-2304-02017.title: Unlocking the Potential of ChatGPT: A Comprehensive Exploration of its Applications, Advantages, Limitations, and Future Directions in Natural Language Processing
arxiv-2304-02017.creator: Walid Hariri
arxiv-2304-02017.description: Abstract Large language models, pivotal in artificial intelligence, find diverse applications. ChatGPT (Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer), an OpenAI creation, stands out as a widely adopted, powerful tool. It excels in chatbots, content generation, language translation, recommendations, and medical applications, due to its ability to generate human-like responses, comprehend natural language, and adapt contextually.

arxiv-2305-02423.title: PTP: Boosting Stability and Performance of Prompt Tuning with Perturbation-Based Regularizer
arxiv-2305-02423.creator: Lichang Chen, Heng Huang, Minhao Cheng
arxiv-2305-02423.description: Abstract Recent studies show that prompt tuning can better leverage the power of large language models than fine-tuning on downstream natural language understanding tasks. However, the existing prompt tuning methods have training instability issues, as the variance of scores under different random seeds is quite large.

arxiv-2307-10800.title: Contagious McKean–Vlasov problems with common noise: from smooth to singular feedback through hitting times
arxiv-2307-10800.creator: Ben Hambly, Aldaïr Petronilia, Christoph Reisinger, Stefan Rigger, Andreas Søjmark
arxiv-2307-10800.description: Abstract We consider a family of McKean–Vlasov equations arising as the large particle limit of a system of interacting particles on the positive half-line with common noise and feedback. Such systems are motivated by structural models for systemic risk with contagion.

arxiv-2312-06571.title: From Text to Motion: Grounding GPT-4 in a Humanoid Robot “Alter3”
arxiv-2312-06571.creator: Takahide Yoshida, Atsushi Masumori, Takashi Ikegami
arxiv-2312-06571.description: Abstract We report the development of Alter3, a humanoid robot capable of generating spontaneous motion using a Large Language Model (LLM), specifically GPT-4. This achievement was realized by integrating GPT-4 into our proprietary android, Alter3, thereby effectively grounding the LLM with Alter’s bodily movement.

arxiv-2406-04616.title: Evaluating Data-driven Performances of Mixed Integer Bilinear Formulations for Book Placement Planning
arxiv-2406-04616.creator: Xuan Lin, Gabriel I. Fernandez, Dennis W. Hong
arxiv-2406-04616.description: Abstract Mixed integer bilinear programs (MIBLPs) offer tools to resolve robotics motion planning problems with orthogonal rotation matrices or static moment balance, but require long solving times. Recent work utilizing data-driven methods has shown potential to overcome this issue allowing for applications on larger scale problems.

arxiv-2412-11781.title: Bivariate rational approximations of the general temperature integral
arxiv-2412-11781.creator: Alireza Aghili, aghili@iaushiraz.ac.ir, alirezaaghili@yahoo.com, Nadezda Sukhorukova nsukhorukova@swin.edu.au, Julien Ugon julien.ugon@deakin.edu.au
arxiv-2412-11781.description: Abstract The non-isothermal analysis of materials with the application of the Arrhenius equation involves temperature integration. If the frequency factor in the Arrhenius equation depends on temperature with a power-law relationship, the integral is known as the general temperature integral. This integral which has no analytical solution is estimated by the approximation functions with different accuracies.

arxiv-2503-15070.title: MultiBARF: Integrating Imagery of Different Wavelength Regions by Using Neural Radiance Fields
arxiv-2503-15070.creator: Kana Kurata, Hitoshi Niigaki, Xiaojun Wu, and Ryuichi Tanida
arxiv-2503-15070.description: Abstract Optical sensor applications have become popular through digital transformation. Linking observed data to real-world locations and combining different image sensors is essential to make the applications practical and efficient. However, data preparation to try different sensor combinations requires high sensing and image processing expertise.

arxiv-2510-00843.title: Partition functions of two-dimensional Coulomb gases with circular root- and jump-type singularities
arxiv-2510-00843.creator: Kohei Noda
arxiv-2510-00843.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the random polynomial p n ​ ( ρ ) := ∏ j = 1 n ( | z j | − ρ ) p_{n}(\rho):=\prod_{j=1}^{n}(|z_{j}|-\rho) , where the points { z j } j = 1 n \{z_{j}\}_{j=1}^{n} are the eigenvalue moduli of random normal matrices with a radially symmetric potential.

britannica-1911-stewart-dugald.title: Stewart, Dugald (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-stewart-dugald.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-stewart-dugald.description: Article 'Stewart, Dugald' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In 1790 Stewart married a second time. Miss Cranstoun, who became his wife, was a lady of birth and accomplishments, and he was in the habit of submitting to her criticism whatever he wrote. A son and a daughter were the issue of this marriage.

pmc-10709429.title: Contractile ring mechanosensation and its anillin-dependent tuning during early embryogenesis
pmc-10709429.creator: Christina Rou Hsu, Gaganpreet Sangha, Wayne Fan, Joey Zheng, Kenji Sugioka
pmc-10709429.description: Cytokinesis plays crucial roles in morphogenesis. Previous studies have examined how tissue mechanics influences the position and closure direction of the contractile ring. However, the mechanisms by which the ring senses tissue mechanics remain largely elusive. Here, we show the mechanism of contractile ring mechanosensation and its tuning during asymmetric ring closure of Caenorhabditis elegans embryos.

pmc-10747575.title: Snapshot of the Phylogenetic Relationships among Avian Poxviruses Circulating in Portugal between 2017 and 2023
pmc-10747575.creator: Daniela Santos, Teresa Fagulha, Margarida Dias Duarte, Ana Duarte, Fernanda Ramos, Sílvia Carla Barros, Tiago Luís, Ana Margarida Henriques, Atsushi Kato
pmc-10747575.description: Simple SummaryAvipoxvirus, the causative agent of avian pox disease, can infect more than 278 species of wild and domestic birds. It causes multiple negative consequences for both the economy and the ecosystem. These include reduced egg production, reduced mating success, growth retardation, and occasionally death.

pmc-11377256.title: Factor analysis and evaluation of one-year test-retest reliability of the 33-item Childhood Trauma Questionnaire in Chinese adolescents
pmc-11377256.creator: Jiamei Zhang, Zhipeng Wu, Min Chen, Yan Gao, Zhening Liu, Yicheng Long, Xudong Chen
pmc-11377256.description: The 33-item Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ-33) is a recently developed tool expanded from the 28-item Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ-28) to assess childhood trauma events, which showed good test-retest reliability over 2 weeks. However, little is known regarding the factor structure and long-term test-retest reliability of the CTQ-33.

pmc-11402741.title: The prognostic utility of 18F-FDG PET parameters in lymphoma patients under CAR-T-cell therapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11402741.creator: Akram Al-Ibraheem, Ahmed Saad Abdlkadir, Dhuha Ali Al-Adhami, Mike Sathekge, Henry Hee-Seung Bom, Mohammad Ma’koseh, Asem Mansour, Hikmat Abdel-Razeq, Kamal Al-Rabi, Enrique Estrada-Lobato, Maysaa Al-Hussaini, Ismail Matalka, Zaid Abdel Rahman, Stephano Fanti
pmc-11402741.description: BackgroundChimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has attracted considerable attention since its recent endorsement by the Food and Drug Administration, as it has emerged as a promising immunotherapeutic modality within the landscape of oncology. This study explores the prognostic utility of [18F]Fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography ([18F]FDG PET) in lymphoma patients undergoing CAR T-cell therapy.

pmc-11449115.title: A Case of Transient Ventilation Difficulty Caused by the Occlusion of a Nasotracheal Intubation Tube Due to the Weight of the Tongue in a Patient With Morbid Obesity
pmc-11449115.creator: Naoko Tachi, Aiji Sato-Boku, Yoko Okumura, Mayumi Hashimoto, Masahiro Okuda
pmc-11449115.description: In patients with obesity, airway obstruction is more likely to occur because of the effects of gravity on the supine position and compression of the airway caused by the weight of soft tissues. This significantly increases the risk of apnea and hypoxemia. Therefore, careful airway monitoring and securing are essential after anesthesia induction and during postoperative recovery.

pmc-11471152.title: Medical Students' Competency in EFAST (Extended Focused Assessment Sonography for Trauma) Components: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-11471152.creator: Munawar Farooq, Arif Alper Cevik, David O Alao, Virgie Guy Pedo, Fikri Abu-Zidan
pmc-11471152.description: Objective: Ultrasound training in undergraduate medical education is developing, and its incorporation into the curriculum requires careful planning. Extended Focused Assessment Sonography for Trauma (EFAST) is commonly taught to medical students as one of the primary applications of ultrasound. Because false-negative EFAST scans can affect patients' clinical outcomes, it is essential to evaluate the individual components of this skill.

pmc-12704114.title: The other Babinski sign in Hemifacial Spasm: a clinical marker of severity and its predictive association with η-like vA-PICA compression
pmc-12704114.creator: Gang Wu, Zihao Zhang, Qingpei Hao, Zeyu Miao, Bin Li, Hu Ding, Ruen Liu
pmc-12704114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo investigate the clinical significance of the other Babinski sign in hemifacial spasm (HFS), focusing on its association with symptom severity and specific neurovascular compression (NVC) patterns.MethodsThis prospective observational study evaluated 69 consecutive HFS patients undergoing microvascular decompression. The association between the other Babinski sign and HSGS scores was assessed using the chi-square test for independence, with Cramer’s V quantifying association strength.

pmc-13028534.title: The Methods for Estimating State of Charge in Lithium-Ion Batteries
pmc-13028534.creator: Peilin Xu, Ruyan Zhou
pmc-13028534.description: It is of great significance in real time to accurately monitor the internal state parameters of lithium-ion batteries toy ensure the safety, reliability and lasting efficiency of battery energy storage systems. The battery management system can monitor the working state, prevent overcharge or overdischarge, and make the working process more safe and reliable.

pmc-13089225.title: The impact of vegetation regeneration succession on soil carbon composition and enzyme activity in the southwestern karst region
pmc-13089225.creator: Jianli Zhang, Yanping Li, Tao Pu, Lihua Pu, Yunjie Wu
pmc-13089225.description: Vegetation regeneration enhances soil carbon sequestration in degraded karst ecosystems. However, how succession influences soil organic carbon (SOC) fractions and enzyme activities remains poorly understood in Southwest China’s karst landscapes. We examined three successional stages (grassland, shrubland, and secondary forest) in Pingtang County, Guizhou Province.

pmc-13599605.title: Developing and piloting an interactive syphilis surveillance dashboard through user-centred design: An implementation report from Interior Health, British Columbia
pmc-13599605.creator: Temuulen Enebish, Barbara Gauthier, Jonathan Malo
pmc-13599605.description: BackgroundSyphilis rates have risen in Canada and British Columbia (BC), increasing the need for timely, small-area intelligence. In BC, 1,983 cases of infectious syphilis were reported in 2024, representing a rate of 34.8 cases per 100,000 population. An additional 27 cases of congenital syphilis were also confirmed. Routine quarterly reporting limits responsiveness when incidence shifts quickly.
